{{Quote|Even though they don't have big payouts, a decent hunter can collar this level of low-grade merchandise again and again, making more in pin money than they would if they spent half a year tracking Jaarl the Conqueror to score a single big payday.|[[Arack Dostryt]], on the merits to [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] of pursuing low-level bounties|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
'''Jaarl the Conqueror''' was an individual active during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] upon whom a large [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was placed.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" />
